title: WAPC approval of average site area variation over 5% for corner and dual-frontage lots (R10 to R35)
text: In addition to M4.1.2, the WAPC, in consultation with the local government, may approve the creation of a green title lot, survey-strata lot or strata lot with an average lot size variation greater than five percent than that specified in Table 3B for R10 to R35 lots (base code applied for dual coded land), provided that: i. the site is a corner lot with frontage to two different streets or any other lot with frontage to more than one dedicated street (excluding a primary (red), other regional (blue) or any other major road, including state and federal highways, with access restrictions); ii. all proposed lots comply with the minimum lot size and frontage provisions specified in Table 3B; iii. the width and frontage of the new lots will enable dwellings to have their primary frontage to the different streets; iv. crossovers and driveways to proposed lots are provided in accordance with Australian Standard (AS) 2890 and C3.7 Access; and v. any corner truncation, pedestrian access way, vehicle right of way or laneway widening is excluded from the calculation of the minimum lot size.

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

verified.note: Text checked; coding R10 to R35 as printed. The pink callout (local government approval for corner lots) is a potential change only.

notes: diverges: Chapter 3 wording (p52) reads 'may approve the creation of a green title lot, survey-strata lot or strata lot with an average lot size variation', where Chapter 2 reads 'may approve any average lot size variation'; Table 3B for Table 2B. WAPC discretion. ToC says 'R25 and R35 lots'; the text says R10 to R35. Pink callout: development-approval route for corner lots is a flagged potential change.
